extra.final_summary:
Average body mass (grams) per species, using 54 valid rows:
- Adelie: 3500.0 g
- Chinstrap: 3907.81 g
- Gentoo: 5248.33 g

Problems found & fixed:
1. species had misspellings "Adeile" (row 2) and "Gentto" (rows 27, 40) → normalized to Adelie/Gentoo (approved).
2. body_mass_g was stored as text (one comma-formatted value "3,800") → cast to numeric.
3. Three rows had impossible body masses (3,650,000 / 3,500,000 / 6,000,000 g, far outside the 2500–6500 g rule range) → excluded (rows 0, 17, 34; approved).

No duplicate rows. Caveat: the 3 excluded rows each belonged to a species, so their averages are computed from the remaining valid rows only.
